mapper.select: SELECT dv.* FROM zentide_document_version dv LEFT JOIN zentide_retrieval_chunk rc ON rc.document_version_id=dv.document_version_id AND rc.status='ACTIVE' WHERE rc.chunk_id IS NULL ORDER BY dv.document_version_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT rc.chunk_id AS chunkId, rc.chunk_text AS excerpt, dv.title, s.source_id AS sourceId, s.source_name AS sourceName, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(e.source_url) FROM zentide_evidence e JOIN zentide_change c ON c.change_id=e.change_id WHERE e.document_version_id=dv.document_version_id AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.verification_status='VERIFIED'), s.canonical_url) AS sourceUrl, dv.document_version_id AS documentVersionId, dv.published_at AS publishedAt, dv.content_hash AS contentHash, (SELECT MIN(e.evidence_id) FROM zentide_evidence e JOIN zentide_change c ON c.change_id=e.change_id WHERE e.document_version_id=dv.document_version_id AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.verification_status='VERIFIED') AS evidenceId, (SELECT MIN(c.change_id) FROM zentide_evidence e JOIN zentide_change c ON c.change_id=e.change_id WHERE e.document_version_id=dv.document_version_id AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.verification_status='VERIFIED') AS changeId FROM zentide_retrieval_chunk rc JOIN zentide_document_version dv ON dv.document_version_id=rc.document_version_id JOIN zentide_document d ON d.document_id=dv.document_id JOIN zentide_source s ON s.source_id=d.source_id WHERE rc.status='ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zentide_evidence e JOIN zentide_change c ON c.change_id=e.change_id WHERE e.document_version_id=dv.document_version_id AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.verification_status='VERIFIED') AND (LOWER(rc.chunk_text) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{query}),'%') OR LOWER(dv.title) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{query}),'%')) ORDER BY COALESCE(dv.published_at,dv.created_at) DESC, rc.chunk_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
